caption:
Can you use Wegovy when planning a pregnancy?

Labels advise stopping semaglutide ahead of a planned pregnancy because it takes weeks to clear the body. Weight-loss medicines are not recommended during pregnancy. Talk to your doctor. Did you know this? Yes or no.
